settings.print_settings_id: O23I A1 mini PLA / unified mount contours

clearance.name: unified_fine_caps2
clearance.scope: Actual support/interface/transition LINE_WIDTH per segment plus0.02 mm arc margin; lower/middle/upper cross-sections per support layer. Local clearance screen, no physical removal guarantee.

islands.name: unified_fine_caps2
islands.scope: All raw unsupported beads remain recorded. Internal starts require >99.5% bbox coverage with the established +0.015 mm CAD allowance, or, only for footprints <0.5 mm2, >99.5% coverage of a 0.025 mm tube around their actual extrusion centrelines by the undilated preceding nominal solid. This distinguishes small perimeter starts above interior infill gaps from exterior unsupported geometry; it does not certify physical infill or bridge strength. All remaining exterior islands must be absent.

caps.scope: Temporary caps: closed nominal geometry, >=0.18 mm nominal model separation; actual declared-width bead slabs >=0.15 mm apart, allowing 0.001 mm rounding; starting layer supported. Physical removal not tested.
